questions.stem: What fraction of the interval from 2 to 10 is the part from 2 to 4?
questions.explain: The whole interval has length 8 and the part has length 2, so the fraction is 2/8 = 1/4 = 0.25.
Multiply both sides by 2 to get x − 10 = 3, so x = 13.

questions.stem: What is the integral of 2x from 1 to 3?
questions.explain: An anti-derivative of 2x is x². Evaluating gives 3² − 1² = 9 − 1 = 8.

questions.stem: The CDF of X satisfies F(5) = 0.9 and F(2) = 0.3. What is P(2 < X ≤ 5)?
questions.explain: An interval probability is the difference of the CDF values: F(5) − F(2) = 0.9 − 0.3 = 0.6.

questions.stem: As x grows without bound, what does $e^{-x}$ approach?
questions.explain: e⁻ˣ = 1 / eˣ, and eˣ grows without bound, so its reciprocal shrinks towards 0.
